This section covers type 1 diabetes (T1D) physiology for games that represent glucose, insulin, meals or activity. It is not required for every psychosocial, narrative or communication game.

1. [The glucose–insulin system](glucose-insulin-system.qmd): glucose sources and disposal, tissue-specific insulin action, counterregulation and measurement lag.
2. [Meals, insulin and exercise](meals-insulin-exercise.qmd): absorption, delayed action and overlapping processes.
3. [Variability and safety](variability-and-safety.qmd): sleep, illness, stress, alcohol, tissue conditions and acute safety concepts.
4. [Model families](model-families.qmd): alternative model structures, assumptions and validation.

The chapters distinguish physiological evidence from modelling proposals. Quantitative anchors retain their experimental populations and limitations; none should be converted into a personal prediction or dose recommendation. Detailed immunology, long-term complications and individual treatment algorithms are outside this module.
